reuse.why: Uses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance and getRangeAmount for ranges, and keeps getScheduledAmount as the client-facing helper.

duplication.why: Removes three inline missing/number/range dispatches (schedules/app.ts x2, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) and two partial ones by routing them through a single getPlannedAmount.

placement.why: The planned-amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount, importing the tolerance from shared/rules.

scope.why: All edits route callers through the new rule; the forecast-schedules op selection and RawScheduleData field are needed, and the touches stay on topic.

maintainability.why: One function owns the worst-case rule for every path; having both getPlannedAmount and getScheduledAmount (a thin inverse wrapper) and an optional untyped op string are minor rough edges.

one_place.where: getPlannedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts (via getScheduledAmount for client callers), used by preview, posting, updateActions, forecast, budget templates, API and the desktop lists/balance
